newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Baloise to pay back capital, split share.
newsitem.headline: Baloise to pay back capital, split share.

text.p: Baloise Insurance Group said it planned a capital repayment in 1997 of 80 Swiss francs per registered share rather than a dividend on 1996 results, after a dividend of 47 Swiss francs this year.
The life and non-life insurer said that after the pay back, it would split its shares at a ratio of two for one and wind up with a nominal value of 10 Swiss francs.

The capital repayment totalling 88 million Swiss francs was planned for September 1997 pending approval by next year's annual shareholder meeting, Baloise said in a statement released at a news conference.
After the split, shares would total 2.189 million.
Baloise said the repayment would reduce equity by about three percent of the most recent total of 3.1 billion Swiss francs.
